records.reason: The report's recurrence sign convention with its stated coefficient centers the all-pass at Nyquist-fc, not fc. Native implementation has a 3 kHz/48 kHz phase-center test at -90 degrees.
records.evidence: shared DSP implementation review and Native phase test; do not cite the old report formula as the corrected contract

records.invalidClaim: The old benchmark's clamp antiderivative is globally an antiderivative of the clipped transfer function.
records.reason: The previous expression did not satisfy F'=f globally. The corrected candidate integrates the clipped cubic without clamping input before integration. Validate derivative, continuity, alias rejection and numerical edge cases in actual tests.
records.latencyNote: No whole-sample buffer does not imply literal zero delay; first-order ADAA divided differences have frequency-dependent small-signal group delay (about 0.5 sample at low frequencies).

records.finding: The old browser benchmark multiplied by 1/sqrt(8) at each of three Hadamard stages, yielding an aggregate matrix norm near 1/8 rather than an orthogonal transform. Native source applies one final 1/sqrt(8) normalization.
records.qualification: Old Native and Web FDN benchmark numbers are not equivalent and cannot qualify product Gate3/Gate7.

records.finding: The old seed expression seed>>8 produces a nonnegative range (reported as 0..2), not bipolar white noise.
records.qualification: Noise-based quality results from that path cannot qualify product stochastic/noise behavior until the stimulus is corrected and independently checked.
